title: The Easycraft Project
description: Vanilla+ Modpack that Aims to expand the classical minecraft experience
body:
# THE EASYCRAFT PROJECT

Ever wanted to play a vanilla+ modpack that adds tons of content but the big projects are not in the most current version? Well wait no more! and let us introduce you to:
**_The Easycraft project_**

This is a Vanilla+ modpack for those who like more variety and exploration, with almost 200 mods you will have no time to get bored here, every chunk will have new features for you to discover, from new structures, to farming, to dimensions and bosses, anything you want will be here.

## EXPLORE
With new biomes and structure mods, you can spend hour travelling throught the world appreciating the view thanks to tectonic, find new dungeons, find one of the many biomes, rediscover vanilla biomes with blooming biosphere, and much more content that will surprise you

## BUILD
Thanks to the creativity of mod creators this modpack has tons of new blocks that will give your building infinite new possibilities with new blocks from both vanilla and mods, and QoS additions that will help you build faster and better than ever

## FARM
Either if by farming you mean crops or gigantic redstone machines, this mod will help you with both with very interesting new features, from auto farming to WIRELESS REDSTONE, this modpack has something to impress you

## DISCOVER
- Dungeons
- New challenges
- New biome strongholds
- new more fun way to reach the end
- New bosses
- New weapons

## PROGRESS EVEN FURTHER
Protection IV Netherite is no more the strongest gear, FAR FROM THAT, find new ways to progress and discover a new system to become the strongest you've ever been in a vanilla+ modpack.
Althought this modpack does not forget about the mid-game experience, new sets of armor were added that you can find to have an entire collection of gears to every situation and style.


<details>
<summary>Release</summary>

This is a complete 1.0 release, but in the following days I will be tweaking configuration from different mods to finish the final touches, but as of right now the modpakc is complete and all mods are working, I will be just polishing the details, also I made this modpack alone Idk why I talked about us before.

</details>


<details>
  <summary>Future plans</summary>

The aether 2 mod will be added if they update to 1.21.11 either for fabric or forge.

More bosses will be added when a great and challenging bosses mod drops in this same version, and that should be about it

I will personally learn to code to make a final boss for the end dimension, the idea is a big empty castle where you will maybe find new mobs and loot, and at the center of the structure sitting there waiting will be "The last survivor of the end" who will be the last of the people who built the ancient cities and were also the responsibles of leaving the end dimension in it's original state, the intended design is for this boss to be like a player from a forgotten civilization that collapsed in a war and they had to scape to the end but they drained all the resources and trapped themselves there sealing their destiny.


</details>
